pages.text: On $(l)PLACE A BOUNTY$(), pick the player, then the reward: pieces from your bank, or coins of one tier from your inventory. Staff, new players still under protection and you yourself cannot be targets.$(br2)Add notes if you like. Only hunters who accept the bounty read them.

Pick how long it runs, from an hour to 30 days. A $(l)bonus$() is an extra amount paid only if the kill comes within its own, shorter window; after that it comes back to you.$(br2)You pay the reward, the bonus and a 5% fee into the $(l:coins/lottery)lottery$() pot when you place it.
pages.title: Time and bonus

pages.text: If nobody claims it, the reward and bonus come back when it ends; coins wait in your $(l)Collect$() box. You may cancel while nobody has accepted it. The fee stays paid either way.$(br2)The target hears that there is a price on their head. The posters say who offered it.
pages.title: When it ends
